## What's changed

- Prevents Library Optimization from appearing to start and then silently stopping while Breaks & Credits analysis is using FFmpeg, the GPU, or the media drive.
- Starts optimizer preparation in the background so the server API remains responsive during hardware detection and queue preparation.
- Lets active Breaks & Credits files finish, pauses new marker work while Library Optimization is preparing or running, and resumes the marker queue automatically afterward.
- Clearly shows when Library Optimization is waiting for Breaks & Credits and when marker analysis is waiting for Library Optimization.
- Adds persistent all-time Library Optimization statistics for completed files and total space saved, kept separately from the counters for the current run.
- Migrates existing successful optimizer history into the all-time total and preserves it across runs, restarts, container recreation, and server updates.
- Keeps preparation failures visible in Library Optimization status instead of leaving the job idle without an explanation.

These are server-managed updates. Existing Tater Tube players do not require an update.
